_readme: `branches` says which photo sets appear under which branch of a chapter,
and in what order. The key is chapter/branch. `set` is the folder name
`photos` is the when / where / what / why for a single photo, keyed by
chapter/set/filename with no extension. Every field is optional and a
photo with no entry at all still appears — it just shows without the
four facts around it. Drop all seventy-five in tonight and write these
what: one line. It is also the alt text, so write it for someone who
when: whatever you know. '2023' is a fine answer.
where: the place, not the coordinates.
why: the one that is worth the trouble — why this photo is here.

campus/athletics/EXAMPLE-replace-this-ke.what: One line. It is also the alt text.
